meta.title: Documentation Impact
meta.description: Deterministic documentation impact engine for DeepSeek Harness

en.configFileHint: Relative to the session working directory; .dsh/doc-impact.yml by default.
en.debugHint: Log baselines, change detection, and reminders.
en.enabledHint: When off the plugin stays fully silent and checks nothing.
en.invalidTemplate: The template is missing a required placeholder; keep it to save.
en.limitTemplateHint: Placeholders: {rounds} rounds used, {impacts} unresolved impact list (required).
en.maxReminderRoundsHint: Steer limit for the same impact in strict modes.
en.maxSnapshotFilesHint: Baseline snapshot cap; detection degrades gracefully beyond it.
en.modeHint: Used by workspace rules that do not declare an explicit mode.
en.onLimitHint: allow finishes silently; warn logs; error sends a final notice.
en.readOnly: This connection is read-only; settings cannot be changed.
en.reminderTemplateHint: Placeholders: {intro} attribution line, {count} triggered count, {body} impact list (required), {tail} mode-specific instructions.
en.saveFailed: The save did not land; drafts kept — please retry.
en.steerHint: When off the plugin keeps detecting impacts (tools and /doc-impact work) but never steers a reminder into the agent turn.
en.unavailable: The settings are not available yet: this profile has not returned the plugin's configuration, so nothing here can be read or changed.
